# Tracy

**Tracy** is a real-time, nanosecond-resolution frame profiler specifically designed for C++ applications. It is an open-source tool primarily used for performance analysis and optimization, particularly in areas like game development and other high-performance computing scenarios. 

## Download Sources & Binaries

- **GitHub**: https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy

## Update Rules

1. Update sources (`src/`).
2. Verify compatibility with the project.
3. Update the README (version, download links, etc).
